name: Sun Wukong
title: Monkey King
summary: Summon Clones of Sun Wukong and Mirror the Power of your Foes with Cyclonic Attacks.
lore: The famous Monkey King, central figure of countless myths, spends more time outside Tian than within. Ever curious and ever mischievous, he engages the people and gods of other realms in all manner of games, schemes, and pranks, many of which are ill-appreciated by their unwilling participants. His antics threaten to cause dangerous enmity between these realms and his own.
archetype_description: Increase on hit damage by 1% for each piece of leather armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Each hit has a 50% chance to mirror 1 random Buff from the target.

If a clone strikes the same target more than once, has a 50% chance to inflict additional damage 72%ATK to all other enemies.

If there are no other enemies has a 50% chance to inflict the damage to the initial target instead.
Will always join the attack with a hero from Tian.
